title: maturity
description: One still frame from an explainer video, rated for how mature and professional it looks to adult professionals (D-102 E3). The same 1-5 anchors the human rater used.

what_is_shown.description: Plain description of the frame before any judgement: subject, setting, people, text, style.

score.description: 1 childish (toy-like, a kids' app or a school slide); 2 amateur; 3 passable (nothing wrong, nothing good); 4 professional (would ship in a paid corporate course); 5 studio (broadcast or top-channel quality).

drivers.description: What most drove the score, up or down, most important first.

why.description: One to three sentences naming visible features that set the score.
